episodes.synopsis: Fleeing persecution as a beastman, Michiru journeys to Anima-City, where she meets wolf Shirou amidst the celebrations for the city's 10th anniversary.
episodes.title: Runaway Raccoon

episodes.synopsis: Michiru can't prove she was human without her stolen student ID, so she heads to Rabbit Town to retrieve it. Shirou meets with the mayor.
episodes.title: Rabbit Town

episodes.synopsis: The mayor asks Shirou to investigate a series of bombings. Michiru talks her way into joining him, with the goal of protecting a medical center.
episodes.title: Rhino Melancholy

episodes.synopsis: Using an illegal SIM card, Michiru befriends influencer Nina, who's fascinated by humans. The two of them sneak out to a party in the human world.
episodes.title: Dolphin Daydream

episodes.synopsis: Though she prefers basketball, Michiru reluctantly joins a hard-luck baseball team whose hangdog coach is on the sports betting take.
episodes.title: Greedy Bears

episodes.synopsis: The Church of the Silver Wolf arrives in Anima-City. Michiru is shocked to learn that their leader is her friend Nazuna, who was once human like her.
episodes.title: Fox Waltz

episodes.synopsis: Michiru meets albatross beastman Pingua when he crash lands in her house. Shirou has an encounter with Alan Sylvasta in the mayor's office.
episodes.title: Easy Albatross

episodes.synopsis: After a visit from Boris, Yaba morphs into an uncontrollable beast form. The mayor tells Michiru the true history of the silver wolf.
episodes.title: The Mole Rat Speaks

episodes.synopsis: While Shirou investigates what happened to Yaba, Michiru sneaks into the Sylvasta medical center after seeing Nazuna kidnapped once again.
episodes.title: Human Scapegoat

episodes.synopsis: Shirou and Michiru set out to subdue another monstrous beastman. After Sylvasta's machines interfere, Alan tells them about Nirvasyl Syndrome.
episodes.title: Rabid Wolf

episodes.synopsis: Nazuna decides to reveal she's human during her concert. While the mayor escapes detention in Japan, Shirou and Flip put their own plans into action.
episodes.title: A Beastly Feast

episodes.synopsis: The mayor proves that a serum based on Michiru's blood cures Nirvasyl Syndrome, but Alan moves forward with his plan to "solve" the beastman problem.
episodes.title: Anima-City
